task.title: Actioning a pending claimant’s report on the E-Report tab

step.cmd: On the E-Report tab, select the pending claimant’s report and review the information provided by the client.
In NWS, determine if there is a completed claimant’s report checklist:

ul.li: If there is no completed checklist (or if the checklist is incomplete), fact-find with the client using the Claimant Report with no Paycoding or Claimant Report with Paycoding checklist and go to step 4. fact-find Claimant Report with no Paycoding Claimant Report with Paycoding
If there is a completed checklist and additional details are not needed, go to step 6.

step.cmd: Determine if the client was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client was contacted, go to step 5.
If the client was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 letter, go to step 8.

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Details: Copy and paste the Claimant Report with no Paycoding or Claimant Report with Paycoding checklist. Document any additional fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Claimant Report with no Paycoding Claimant Report with Paycoding Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy

step.cmd: Review the claimant’s report chart to determine if additional actions are required (e.g. if earnings are declared, an allocation may be required instead of coding the earnings).
In FTS, on the E-Report tab, select the pending claimant’s report:

ul.li: Send message to SCC: Leave this field blank.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if a WI exists for the pending claimant’s report issue:

ul.li: If no, no further action is required.
